mgs-001.front: Name the 4 goose groups that count in BC.
mgs-001.back: Canada and cackling (together), snow and Ross's (together), white fronted, brant (99%).

Snow and Ross's geese, white with black wingtips and pink bills, a big and a small one: counted together, 5 a day, more in MUs 2-4 and 2-5. White fronted geese, the specklebelly, grey brown with a white face at the bill and black bars on the belly: 5 a day. mgs-003.front: Can you tell a gander from a goose by colour?
mgs-003.back: No. Sexes look alike (85%). The gander is a bit bigger (75%) and guards and leads.
mgs-003.diagram:

mgs-004.front: Cackling goose bill length vs Canada goose?
mgs-004.back: Cackling 2.8 to 3.8 cm; Canada 4.1 to 5.8 cm (75%).
mgs-004.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Side by side: a Canada goose with a long neck, a bill 4.1 to 5.8 centimetres long and a deep honk, and a smaller cackling goose with a stubby bill 2.8 to 3.8 centimetres long, a short neck and a high yelp, 75 percent. Both count in one bag of 10 a day, 99 percent.">

mgs-005.front: Is a cackling goose a young Canada goose?
mgs-005.back: No. It is a separate species (85%). Same bag as Canada geese: 10 a day together (99%).

mgs-006.front: Average weight of a cackling goose?
mgs-006.back: Males about 1.5 kg, females about 0.95 kg (75%).

mgs-007.front: Canada goose weight range by race?
mgs-007.back: About 2.4 to 9 kg (Ducks Unlimited, 75%). Most you see: 1.35 to 5.45 kg (80%).

mgs-008.back: About 90 cm to 2 m, by race (80%).

mgs-009.front: How many races of Canada goose does Hinterland Who's Who count?
mgs-009.back: 11. Four former races now form the cackling goose (80%).

mgs-010.front: Where did Okanagan nesting geese come from?
mgs-010.back: Hybrids of races introduced in the 1960s and 70s; they never learned to migrate (85%).

mgs-012.back: Ross's: smaller, stubby bill, no grin patch, warty bluish base on older birds (70 to 80%).

mgs-013.front: All white bird, bigger than a goose, no black wing tips?
mgs-013.back: A swan. No open season. Never shoot (90%).

mgs-014.front: White fronted goose nickname and why?
mgs-014.back: Specklebelly: black bars on the belly (70%).

mgs-015.front: White fronted goose daily limit in Districts 2, 3 and 8?

mgs-016.front: Brant: where and when can you hunt them?
mgs-016.back: Only MU 2-4, 1 to 10 March, 3 a day. None in Districts 3 and 8 (99%).

mgs-017.front: Snow and Ross's limit in Districts 3 and 8?

mgs-018.front: District 2 snow goose limit, federal table?
mgs-018.back: 10 a day, not more than 5 Ross's; 5 more snow geese in MUs 2-4 and 2-5 (99%). Region 2 Rule Book: VERIFY for 2-8, take 5 to be safe (Tip).

mgs-020.front: Canada geese in North America, 1950 vs now?
mgs-020.back: About 1 million in 1950; more than 8 million before the fall hunt now (80%).

mgs-021.front: Fraser delta snow geese vs marsh capacity?
mgs-021.back: About 80,000 wintered in 2004 to 2005; the marsh alone feeds about 17,500 (85%).

mgs-023.back: 9 (85%). They pump air one way through the lungs.

mgs-024.back: About one fifth, vs one twentieth in a mammal (80%).

mgs-045.front: Are electronic goose calls legal in BC?
mgs-045.back: No (99%). Mouth calls and flags are fine (95%).

mgs-051.front: When do geese pair and first nest?
mgs-051.back: Pair in year 2, usually for life; first nest at 2 or 3 (80%).

mgs-052.front: Where do geese usually feed in the morning?
mgs-052.back: In the field they used the afternoon before (65%).

mgs-053.front: Same spread, same field, every hunt: what happens?
mgs-053.back: Local birds learn it and avoid it. Change the spread (65%).

mgs-067.front: Below what sunrise temperature did geese skip the dawn flight?

mgs-068.front: Clear evening: when do geese return to the roost?
mgs-068.back: Between sunset and civil twilight (80%). Before sunset if cloudy.

mgs-069.front: Effect of a visible full moon?
mgs-069.back: Later evening return (80%). Night feeding: proven in barnacle geese, lore in Canada geese (Tip).

mgs-070.front: Does barometric pressure drive goose feeding?
mgs-070.back: No study found. Treat as lore (VERIFY).

mgs-100.back: Steel 2 or 4 at about 14 m (15 yd) (65%).

mgs-101.front: A hit goose sails off. What now?
mgs-101.back: Mark it, then kill and retrieve as soon as you can (99%).

mgs-102.back: A fully feathered wing or the head (99%).

</svg>

mgs-103.front: Bird flu care when cleaning geese?
mgs-103.back: Gloves, clean outdoors, wash hands, skip sick birds, cook to 74°C (80%).
